title: Another X-ray UFO without a momentum-boosted molecular outflow. ALMA CO(1-0) observations of the galaxy pair IRAS 05054+1718
question: Investigate the presence of a large-scale molecular outflow in the galaxy pair IRAS 05054+1718 (NED01 and NED02) and test the AGN feedback blast-wave scenario by comparing molecular outflow and X-ray ultra-fast outflow energetics.

data.sensitivity: 2.2 mJy beam^-1 (NED01) and 4.0 mJy beam^-1 (NED02) per 5.2 km s^-1 channel

what.value: Swift-XRT spectrum of NED01 from 2014 monitoring

evidence.quote: while for the *Swift* monitoring we consider the spectrum extracted by (cite: 2015Ballo).

what.value: CO-to-H2 conversion factor for molecular outflows alpha_CO = 2.1 ± 1.2 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1

evidence.quote: In this work we assume that molecular outflows have an $\alpha_{\rm CO}$=2.1$\pm$1.2 M$_\odot$ (K km s$^{-1}$ pc$^2$), which is the value measured by (cite: 2018Cicone2) on the molecular outflow of the well-studied local ULIRG NGC 6240.

what.value: CO-to-H2 conversion factor for galaxy disks alpha_CO = 4.3 ± 1.3 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1

evidence.quote: We use $\alpha_{\rm CO}$=4.3$\pm$1.3 M$_\odot$ (K km s$^{-1}$ pc$^2$), a value typically assumed when treating the molecular ISM of isolated galaxies like the Milky Way (cite: 2013Bolatto), to evaluate the molecular mass of the galaxy disk.

what.value: Galactic H I column density in the direction of NED01 (N_H = 1.93 x 10^21 cm^-2)

evidence.quote: in all the models we included the galactic absorption in the direction of NED01 ($N_{\mbox{\scriptsize H}}=1.93\times 10^{21}$ cm$^{-2}$, (cite: nhHI4PICollaboration))

what.value: Black hole mass of NED01 (~10^8 M_sun)

evidence.loc: The X-ray disk wind energetics of NED01
evidence.quote: Considering a BH mass of $\sim 10^8 M_\odot$, as estimated by (cite: Alonso13) in NED01

what.value: Previous redshift estimate of NED01 (z = 0.0184) from HyperLeda catalogue

evidence.quote: expected from a previous redshift estimate of this source ($z=0.0184$), derived from the heliocentric velocity (error-weighted average of the optical and radio velocities) reported in the HyperLeda catalogue (cite: 2014Makarov).

what.value: Previous redshift estimate of NED02 (z = 0.016842) from 2MASS Redshift Survey

evidence.quote: The previous redshift estimate for this source, $z=0.016842$, derived from the heliocentric velocity reported in the 2MASS *Redshift Survey* (cite: 2012Huchra)

what.value: Sample of objects with observed X-ray UFOs and large-scale galactic outflows for comparison plots

evidence.quote: (cite: 2019Smith) recently summarised the momentum rate versus the wind velocity for a sample of ten objects with observed X-ray UFOs and large-scale galactic outflows (see also Fig. 16, this work).
Following (cite: 2020Marasco; 2021Tozzi), we extended this analysis including our targets and some sources from (cite: 2019Mizumoto).

recipe.goal: Image and measure 3 mm continuum emission
recipe.method: Combine the two low-resolution line-free spectral windows (4 GHz bandwidth) and fit 2D Gaussians on the primary-beam corrected map.
key_parameters: Spectral windows centred at 101.190 GHz and 99.387 GHz, total bandwidth = 4 GHz

recipe.goal: Extract total CO(1-0) spectra, fit Gaussian profiles, refine systemic redshifts, and derive total molecular gas masses
recipe.method: Fit single and double Gaussian functions to continuum-subtracted CO(1-0) spectra to determine central sky frequencies and systemic redshifts, then compute line luminosities and molecular gas masses from redshift-corrected cubes.
key_parameters: PV diagram slit sizes ~30'' and ~9'' aligned with major and minor axes of NED01
assumptions: alpha_CO = 4.3 ± 1.3 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1 for galaxy disks
Systematic flux calibration error of 5% included in integrated flux uncertainties

recipe.goal: Construct CO(1-0) moment maps and characterize disk substructures
recipe.method: Compute zeroth, first, and second moment maps for NED01 (PB-corrected cube) and NED02 (non-PB-corrected cube), and fit spectra of extended components B and C.
key_parameters: Intensity threshold of 0.01 Jy beam^-1 and box size 30'' for NED01 moment maps
assumptions: alpha_CO = 4.3 ± 1.3 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1 for components B and C

recipe.goal: Model rotating CO(1-0) disk kinematics and extract non-rotational residuals
recipe.method: Crop continuum-subtracted datacubes with imsubimage, export with exportfits, fit concentric tilted-ring rotating disk models with 3D-BAROLO, subtract best-fit model cubes from data, and fit double-Gaussian functions to residual spectra.
key_parameters: NED01: v in [-600, +600] km s^-1, PA = 95° ± 10° (fixed), inclination = 45° ± 15° (fixed), S/N > 2.3; Big region = 35''x35'' (7 rings of 2'' width), Medium = 16''x15'' (7 rings of 2''), Small = 10''x8'' (3 rings of 2''); residual box 8.4''x8.4''
NED02: non-PB-corrected cube, box 27.4''x25.4'', v in [-1000, +1000] km s^-1, PA = 120° ± 10°, inclination = 70° ± 15°, S/N > 3, 5 rings of 2'' width; residual box 8''x8''
assumptions: Line emission is distributed in a geometrically thin disk dominated by pure rotational motion
alpha_CO = 2.1 ± 1.2 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1 for residual/outflow gas mass

recipe.goal: Reduce X-ray observations and fit X-ray spectra to characterize the nuclear UFO
recipe.method: Reduce XMM-Newton (SAS) and NuSTAR (NUSTARDAS) data, extract source and background spectra, and perform joint spectral fits in XSPEC for 2012-2014 (NuSTAR+Swift) and 2021 (XMM+NuSTAR) epochs using baseline continuum plus XSTAR photoionised absorber grids.
key_parameters: XMM extraction: 20'' radius circular regions, binned to >= 100 counts/bin; NuSTAR extraction: 50'' radius circular regions, CALDB 20220426, NUCALSAA mode 'optimised', binned to >= 100 counts/bin (50 counts/bin for strictly simultaneous 2021 GTI); Swift binned to >= 20 counts/bin
XSTAR grid: v_turb = 5000 km s^-1, N_H = 10^21 - 3x10^24 cm^-2, log xi = 1 - 6
assumptions: Galactic absorption N_H = 1.93 x 10^21 cm^-2 modelled with tbabs; distant reflection modelled with XILLVER; ionisation parameter log xi tied between 2012 NuSTAR and 2014 Swift

recipe.goal: Compute X-ray wind and putative molecular outflow energetics and test feedback scenarios
recipe.method: Compute X-ray wind mass outflow rate, kinetic power, and momentum rate assuming biconical escape-radius launch; compute putative molecular outflow dynamical timescale, mass outflow rate, momentum rate, and kinetic power from CO residual components; compare momentum rate ratios and CO-derived SFRs.
key_parameters: X-ray wind: mu = 1.2, Omega/4pi = 0.5, R_min = 2 G M_BH / v^2, accretion efficiency eta = 0.1, M_BH ~ 10^8 M_sun
Molecular outflow: tau_dyn = R / v_out; alpha_CO = 2.1 ± 1.2 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1 (and 0.8 ± 1.2 for Fig. 17 comparison)
assumptions: Cosmology: H0 = 67.8 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_Lambda = 0.692, Omega_M = 0.308
Maximum coupling efficiency of ~10% for star formation feedback

score_reason: The ALMA data reduction, continuum subtraction (including exact frequency ranges), imaging parameters (CASA versions, robust=0, cell size, threshold, automasking), and 3D-BAROLO ring geometry (number of rings, ring width, PA, inclination, S/N cut, cropping boxes, velocity integration ranges) are well documented and all key numeric outputs are tabulated. Minor deductions for unstated 3D-BAROLO secondary parameters, total spectrum extraction apertures, and custom XSTAR grid files.
rediscovery_reason: The ALMA dataset (2016.1.00694.S) is public in the ALMA archive, the CASA imaging and 3D-BAROLO kinematic modelling recipe is detailed enough to re-execute, and the main results (redshifts, continuum and CO fluxes, molecular masses, residual component parameters, and upper limits on outflow energetics) are concrete numeric values.
